name: POST /api/billing/checkout - start a Stripe Checkout for a plan or credit pack
description: A firm can choose a self-serve plan and buy credits (F6.3). Body { priceId } of a catalog price; returns the Stripe Checkout URL and session id (subscription mode for a plan, payment mode for credits; the firm's Stripe customer is created on first use). Needs billing:manage; audited. Prices live in Stripe: the catalog is every active Stripe price tagged metadata app=medexregai with kind=plan (recurring) or kind=credits (one-time, metadata credits). Payment happens on Stripe Checkout (card data never reaches MedexRegAI); Stripe's signed webhook then sets the plan or adds the credits, once per event and once per payment. Dev uses Stripe TEST mode. Fixture 55_billing.py proves the purchase, duplicate, bad-signature, plan and cancel paths with signed test events.

errorCases.message: priceId must be a Stripe price id
errorCases.when: priceId missing or malformed, or an unknown field

errorCases.message: That plan or credit pack is not offered
errorCases.when: a price that is not in the catalog (inactive or not tagged app=medexregai)

errorCases.message: Billing is not set up on this server (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is empty).
errorCases.notReproducibleReason: The test environment has Stripe test keys.

errorCases.when: caller lacks billing:manage (only owners have it)
errorCases.notReproducibleReason: Fixture firms have only an owner.
